_note: The M1 acceptance table (Spec §12.3, §13 M1) over the hand-written corpus beside it. It is data, not code, so `vsir demo exact --synthetic` and tests/api/test_acceptance_synthetic.py assert the same numbers. Nothing here may be re-baselined to make a run green (C10): a disagreement is a finding.

decoy.label: SF 1.1A
decoy.why: the tokens sf, 1 and 1a are all on p008 and none is adjacent to the next, so any-order matching returns it and a phrase does not (F1)

hallucinated.label: K999
hallucinated.why: claimed in content.codes, absent from text. Reachable only through unverified_hits, always verified:false (I2, F14, D3). No token of the label occurs anywhere in the text surface, so there is no move to suggest either.

no_text.label: SF 9.9
no_text.why: the only candidate page has no text layer: escalate to vision, never conclude the code does not exist (F4)

untrusted.label: K404
untrusted.why: text_trust: untrusted counts as unsearchable for lookup (§5.7), so the phrase in a garbled text layer is never a verified hit

weak.why: weak = total > max(WEAK_ABS, 0.25 * scope pages) — a server constant, so cap cannot move it (§7.1)

suggest.label: alarm 152
suggest.why: §12.3 — alarm is on p024, 152 is on p026, the phrase is nowhere. The status stays honest and the affordance stops the agent abstaining on a phrasing accident

asymmetric_variant.label: SF1.1A
asymmetric_variant.why: p001 prints the spaced form and variants() cannot produce it from the compact one: re-spacing a bare label spaces EVERY letter-digit boundary (SF 1.1 A), never just one. A recall gap by construction (§5.6, R1), and it degrades to an honest abstention carrying a next move — never to a wrong page

superseded.label: SF 7.7A
superseded.why: printed only on the is_current:false revision 0.9 page; every tool injects is_current:true (I7). F9's found_only_in_superseded upgrade is closed at M8

superseded.label: K 158
superseded.why: printed on both revisions; only the current one can answer

out_of_scope.label: SF 1.1A
out_of_scope.why: no page matched the filters — re-orient and widen; the corpus was never asked (§7.1)

observed_tokens.why: §6.8 — built from the text surface only, and only from tokens carrying at least one digit. `k999` is excluded because it is only ever a model claim (I2); `eao84` because it is a spelling of a query variant and not a token anybody printed; bare words because the inventory exists to back `present_instead` and nothing else
